content: Before S1 can consume any deliberation, require an evidence-reference resolution check that proves each referenced item belongs to the same execution identity/target and is current, attributable, immutable, and gate-local. If any reference is unresolved, stale, historical-only, or from deliberation consensus rather than factual evidence, classify the deliberation input as UNKNOWN/NOT_PROVEN and exclude it from S1 promotion. This is a coordination/input-integrity guard only; it must not mutate current_state or next_action.
next_action: BOT1/BOT2 review this challenge; keep N173/S1 unchanged and require evidence-reference resolution before deliberation material can influence S1 gate evaluation.
